[@Three.js Dev: "Create a standalone Three.js interactive RED FIRE page at D:\Programacion\jpagents\proyects\fuego_rojo\index.html (create the folder if needed). Requirements:

1. USE THREE.JS (NOT p5.js) via importmap from CDN (unpkg or cdnjs)
2. RED FIRE with well-defined flames — debe ser ROJO, no violeta, no naranja. Rojo intenso con llamas bien marcadas.
3. Gradient palette: white-hot center → bright red → deep crimson → dark red → black fade
4. 3000+ particles with THREE.Points + BufferGeometry + ShaderMaterial custom (per-vertex color, size, alpha)
5. Flame movement: sinusoidal sway + micro-turbulence + buoyancy (ascending)
6. Interactive: particles follow mouse, click = explosion, scroll wheel = intensity
7. Opacity fade: starts fading at 65% life, alpha reaches 0 at death
8. Particle size: born at 0.07-0.35 base, expands with age
9. Lifecycle: each particle lives ~3s, auto-recycles (no allocation)
10. Ambient glow: 2 radial sprites (red) that follow mouse
11. Soft fog for distance blending
12. Fullscreen responsive, no scroll, orthographic camera
13. Touch support (tap = explosion, drag = follow finger)
14. Dark background (#0a0000 or similar very dark red/black) to make red fire pop
The page must be a single self-contained index.html file with everything (three.js imported from CDN). No external dependencies."]
